_comment: TEMPLATE: multi-nameset file. One JSON file may contain N namesets under a top-level 'namesets' array. Reduces filesystem churn when several closely-related namesets belong together (e.g. all the regional variants of one culture).
_comment_namespace: File-level namespace applies to every contained nameset that does not declare its own. Per-nameset 'namespace' overrides this.

namesets._comment: Inherits the file-level 'metropolitan' namespace. Full key: 'metropolitan:russian'.
namesets.name: Metropolitan Russian

namesets._comment: Sibling nameset, same file. Could be referenced from an aggregate as 'polish' (bare, resolves within metropolitan namespace) or 'metropolitan:polish' (qualified).
namesets.name: Metropolitan Polish
namesets.description: Interwar Warsaw / Krakow urban Polish names.

namesets._comment: Per-item 'namespace' OVERRIDES the file-level. This nameset lands at 'frontier:russian-emigre' instead of 'metropolitan:russian-emigre'. Useful when one file collects related variants that intentionally span namespaces.
namesets.name: Russian Émigré (Frontier)
namesets.description: Russian-descended names of the colonial frontier — drift toward simpler patronymics and adopted local surnames.
namesets._comment_extends: Inherits everything from metropolitan:russian, then applies the overrides below. See extends.json for the full pattern.
